etymology.root: แจ่ง chaeng — Kam Mueang for a corner or angle; standard Thai mum. The four corners of the moat are the four chaeng, each with its own name.

text.what: The word for the four corners of the moat. A songthaew driver navigates the square by its chaeng, not by street names, and so does this site.
